verdict.rationale: Cal.com's core product is exactly this: a booking-link scheduling platform where invitees pick from live availability, explicitly stated in its own docs ('Share a booking link, connect your calendars, and let people pick a time without the back-and-forth') and backed by API endpoints for slots, event types, schedules, and bookings that implement live availability and booking creation. Community reviews confirm real-world usage as a Calendly alternative for exactly this workflow. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the actual booking-link UX/flow (evidence is docs-heavy) and no direct end-user review specifically praising the no-back-and-forth booking experience itself.
